WITH eligible_customers AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk AS c_customer_sk,
        c.c_birth_year AS c_birth_year,
        ca.ca_country AS ca_country,
        ca.ca_state AS ca_state,
        ca.ca_county AS ca_county
    FROM customer c
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        AND ca.ca_state IN ('AL', 'MO', 'TN', 'GA', 'MT', 'IN', 'CA')
    JOIN customer_demographics cd2
        ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE c.c_birth_month IN (1, 3, 7, 11, 10, 4)
),
eligible_cdemos AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        cd_demo_sk AS cd_demo_sk,
        cd_dep_count AS cd_dep_count
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'F'
      AND cd_education_status = 'Primary'
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id AS i_item_id,
    c.ca_country AS ca_country,
    c.ca_state AS ca_state,
    c.ca_county AS ca_county,
    AVG(CAST(cs.cs_quantity AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg1,
    AVG(CAST(cs.cs_list_price AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg2,
    AVG(CAST(cs.cs_coupon_amt AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg3,
    AVG(CAST(cs.cs_sales_price AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg4,
    AVG(CAST(cs.cs_net_profit AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg5,
    AVG(CAST(c.c_birth_year AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg6,
    AVG(CAST(cd1.cd_dep_count AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg7
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN date_dim d
    ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    AND d.d_year = 2001
JOIN eligible_cdemos cd1
    ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
JOIN eligible_customers c
    ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN item i
    ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i.i_item_id, c.ca_country, c.ca_state, c.ca_county)
ORDER BY c.ca_country, c.ca_state, c.ca_county, i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
